identity.title: The ALMA-PILS survey: isotopic composition of oxygen-containing complex organic molecules toward IRAS 16293-2422B

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this paper we utilise data from the ALMA-PILS survey targeting the protostellar binary IRAS 16293–2422 (IRAS16923 hereafter) using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array.

question.value: What are the deuteration and 13C content of oxygen-bearing complex organic molecules on Solar System scales toward IRAS 16293-2422B?

evidence.quote: The aim of this paper is to systematically survey the deuteration and the $^{13}$C content of a variety of oxygen-bearing complex organic molecules on Solar System scales toward the “B component” of the protostellar binary IRAS 16293–2422.
performed in ALMA’s Cycle 2 (project-id: 2013.1.00278.S)
taken as part of a Cycle 1 program (project-id: 2012.1.00712.S)

bands.value: Band 7 (329.1-362.9 GHz) main survey; Bands 3 and 6 targeted

evidence.quote: covering the frequency range in ALMA’s Band 7 from 329.1 to 362.9 GHz with 0.2 km s$^{-1}$ spectral and $\approx$ 0.5$''$ angular resolution (60 AU diameter)
0.2 km s$^{-1}$ spectral and $\approx$ 0.5$''$ angular resolution (60 AU diameter)

sensitivity.value: ≈5 mJy beam^-1 km s^-1 across the Band 7 range

evidence.quote: reaching a sensitivity of $\approx$5 mJy beam$^{-1}$ km s$^{-1}$ across the entire frequency range

what.value: Laboratory spectroscopy and partition functions from CDMS and JPL catalogs

evidence.quote: The spectroscopic data were taken from the Cologne Database of Molecular Spectroscopy, CDMS (cite: cdms1; cdms2) and the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) (cite: jpl) catalog.

what.value: 16O/18O ratio of 560 to derive CH3OH from CH3(18)OH

evidence.quote: Derived from the $^{18}$O-isotopologue assuming a $^{16}$O/$^{18}$O abundance ratio of 560 (cite: wilson94).
about half that of the standard ratio for the local ISM (cite: milam05)

simulations_or_models_as_data.value: Taquet et al. 2014 model D/H predictions compared with observations

evidence.quote: Fig. [5](#T14_comp) compares the measured D/H ratios to the predictions on interferometric scales at three separate times after collapse

what.value: Data reduction and overview of PILS data

evidence.quote: An overview of the data and reduction as well as first results from the survey are presented in (cite: jorgensen16)
For the identification and modeling of individual species we adopted the same procedure as described in (cite: jorgensen16)

what.value: Source size 0.5'', FWHM 1.0 km/s, LSR velocity 2.5-2.7 km/s

evidence.quote: As noted in previous PILS papers (cite: coutens16; jorgensen16; lykke17), all features toward IRAS16293B are well reproduced with a source size of 0.5$''$, a line width (FWHM) of 1.0 km s$^{-1}$ and a LSR velocity of 2.5–2.7 km s$^{-1}$.

unstated_but_needed: Calibration, CASA version, and imaging parameters (all deferred to Jørgensen et al. 2016)
Exact coordinates of the half-beam and full-beam offset positions
Synthetic spectrum code name and fitting procedure details
Lists of lines used per species and which were excluded

method.value: Spectra taken at positions offset 0.5'' and 1'' from the continuum peak, mainly using the full-beam offset

evidence.quote: In the following work we therefore predominantly focus on the full beam position, but note *(i)* that we check for consistency of the fits toward the half-beam position

analysis_steps.goal: Fit LTE synthetic spectra for column densities and Tex

method.value: Synthetic LTE spectra including optical depth and line overlap compared with observed spectrum; only tau<0.1 transitions used; Tex grouped as 125 K or 300 K

evidence.quote: synthetic spectra are calculated assuming that the emission from the molecules are in Local Thermodynamic Equilibrium (LTE), taking into account optical depth and line overlaps.

key_parameters.value: source size 0.5'', FWHM 1.0 km/s, vLSR 2.5-2.7 km/s fixed

evidence.quote: With those parameters fixed, the remaining quantities to be derived for each species are excitation temperatures and column densities for each species.
the LTE assumption for the complex organic molecules is justified by the high density, $n_{{\rm H}_2}\gtrsim 10^{10}$ cm$^{-3}$

fitting.value: Visual comparison of models; no formal sampler

evidence.quote: The uncertainties for the typical fits can be estimated comparing synthetic diagrams to the observed spectra.

validation.value: Rotation diagrams for CH3OD and a-CH3CHDOH as consistency check; ±20% variation in Tex and N visibly worsens fits

evidence.quote: models with either excitation temperatures or column densities higher or lower by 20% start providing fits that are visibly worse

method.value: Ratios of column densities of isotopologues to main species, corrected for statistical H-atom/C-atom counts

evidence.quote: Table [\[isotopologuetable\]] lists the derived column densities for each of the species and, for the rarer isotopologues, the abundances relative to the main isotopologue.
implies a $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C ratio of 34, about half that of the canonical ISM value
Within the uncertainties quoted above (25 K for an excitation temperature of 125 K and 60 K for a temperature of 300 K)

findings_qualitative.value: First interstellar detections of deuterated/13C ketene, acetaldehyde, formic acid and deuterated ethanol

evidence.quote: The deuterated and $^{13}$C-isotopic species of ketene, acetaldehyde and formic acid, as well as deuterated ethanol, are detected unambiguously for the first time in the interstellar medium.

claims.hypothesis: Do complex organics show distinct D/H groups?
claims.finding: Two groups possibly reflecting formation time in ices

evidence.quote: one group, the simpler species, showing a D/H ratio of $\approx$ 2% and the other, the more complex species, D/H ratios of 4–8%.

claims.hypothesis: Do excitation temperatures differ between species?

evidence.quote: The species show differences in excitation temperatures between 125 K and 300 K.

claims.result: Dimethyl ether lower by up to factor 2; methyl formate and ethanol tentative
claims.finding: Possible late ice formation or FUV effects

evidence.quote: For dimethyl ether the $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C ratio is found to be lower by up to a factor of 2 compared to typical ISM values

limitations_admitted.value: 13C ethanol and methyl formate only tentative; ketene main isotopologue mostly optically thick

evidence.quote: additional observations are needed to confirm and solidify the numbers for these two species

referee_caveats_inferred: Single excitation temperature per species ignores temperature gradients
Uncertainties of 20% are judged by eye, not from a formal fit
Vibrational partition function corrections are uncertain for deuterated species

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Hundreds of GB for the full PILS Band 7 dataset
reproducibility.score_reason: Recipe is described but code, positions and reduction are deferred to prior papers.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Fitting code and details are not given, and results are derived by visual comparison.

methods_papers.why: PILS data reduction and fitting methodology
